role: Minister-Delegate to the Prime Minister, in charge of Relations with Parliament
description: Appointed Minister-Delegate for Relations with Parliament in the second Lecornu government on 12 October 2025; retained in the post in the reshuffle confirmed by decree of 26 February 2026. Acts as liaison between the government and Parliament.

role: President of the LIOT group at the National Assembly
organization: National Assembly (Groupe Libertés, Indépendants, Outre-mer et Territoires)
description: Elected president of the LIOT parliamentary group in February 2025, succeeding Stéphane Lenormand. Stepped down on entering government in autumn 2025.

role: Member of the National Assembly for Ariège's 2nd constituency
description: Deputy for the 2nd constituency of Ariège, elected in 2022 and re-elected in 2024. His seat was suspended on 12 November 2025 (one month after his ministerial appointment), passed to his substitute.
Served as an administrator (board member) of the Institut national du cancer; unremunerated (0 euros declared).
Mayor of Le Fossat from 2014 to 2022, succeeding Bernard Campmas. Resigned as mayor on becoming a deputy (cumul des mandats rules). Remained a municipal councillor afterwards (unremunerated).

role: President of the communauté de communes Arize-Lèze
description: President of the communauté de communes Arize-Lèze from 2017 to 2022.

role: Director of health and social-care establishments (EHPAD)
organization: EHPAD des Portes d'Ariège and other Ariège retirement homes
description: Director of medico-social establishments (EHPAD retirement homes) in Ariège from 2000 to 2022. HATVP records the EHPAD des Portes d'Ariège as employer 08/2020-07/2022, with declared net pay of 22,134 euros (2020), 55,074 euros (2021) and 34,060 euros (2022).
